labels.text: Added directories the agent may read and change:
the agent can no longer reach it

S65.12.needs: a folder on this Mac to add and remove
S65.12.note: The grant is a direct command with no approval prompt, and the code gives no separate on-screen permission dialog for folders. The code path for the agent's own folder access also says 'Local file access: explicit workspace roots only' in the privacy screen. I did not confirm the agent's behaviour after revoke, only the message text.
steps: Open a terminal, run agi, and wait for the prompt.
Type /add-dir ~/Desktop/some-folder (use a real folder on this Mac) and press Return. Look for a line starting with 'added:' that shows the folder path and whether instructions were found.
Type /add-dir alone and press Return. Look for the heading 'Added directories the agent may read and change:' with the folder listed under it.
Type /remove-dir ~/Desktop/some-folder and press Return. Look for 'removed:' followed by 'the agent can no longer reach it'.
Type /add-dir alone again. Compare with Expected: the folder should be gone from the list after the revoke.
S65.12.where: Start the app with agi, then type /add-dir <folder> at the prompt (for example /add-dir ~/Desktop/some-folder). To see the list, type /add-dir with no folder. To revoke, type /remove-dir <folder>. The same grant can also be made at launch with agi --add-dir <folder>.
